goal: Wave 2 build: Model access classification and contract

slices.title: Model access classification and contract
slices.summary: Makes the frontend action registry's model access exhaustive: a typed model-access.ts (none, read or write_approval; a closed exempt-reason set; executor declarations) derives the 8-id eligibility set, catalog-manifest moves to schema version 3 with modelAccess, exemptReason, sideEffectClass and schemaHash, and a canonical agent-action-admission.json is vendored to the Rust, Go and frontend trees. action-registry.ts is not edited and no runtime behaviour changes.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/shared/actions src/shared/context-packs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test agent_action_admission_contract
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib every_ask_read

decisions_defaults.DEC-25: Typed side map `Record<ActionId, ModelAccessEntry>`. The 7 ids stay listed with `executor: none` as visible debt, then demoted per id; `org.*` lifecycle actions need Control-owner review before any agent calls them. Hash: `owner_contract` for `tickets.create`,

slices.notes: Dependency notes: WS12 resolved to WS12-S4 WS08 resolved to WS08-S2 WS26 resolved to WS26-S2
